problem_statement: net_ipaddr_parse() does not bound the port portion of an "address:port" string. When a port number is present, the parser copies the entire remaining input into a small internal buffer sized for the address only, so a long or oversized port string overflows that buffer; it also accepts port text longer than the maximum representable value (e.g. more than 5 digits such as "000080") as if it were a valid port. Parsing such strings must instead reject the input without corrupting memory: an overlong or out-of-range port string must fail to parse, while valid ports (0 through 65535, including a 5-digit value with leading zeros) must still be accepted.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/utils -s tests/net/utils/net.util -s net.util -O twister-out --no-clean -W
